constraints.viewport: 100dvh fixed, NO page-level vertical scroll (lists scroll internally)
constraints.color: Strictly monochrome (black, charcoal, white). NO color accents, NO gradients on dark.

depth_material.shadows_on_dark: Use inner borders (inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05)) combined with dense outer glows (box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08), 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)) for popovers and modals.
depth_material.noise: Apply a 1.5% to 2% opacity white noise/grain texture overlay globally to kill digital flatness.
depth_material.dotted_texture: Subtle radial or linear dotted grid background on the landing page (color: rgba(255,255,255,0.05), size: 1px dots on 24px grid) masking to transparent at the edges.

grids_layouts.global_shell: flex h-[100dvh] w-full overflow-hidden bg-[#080808] text-[#F4F4F5]
grids_layouts.landing_pricing_page: Since 100dvh is fixed, use a 2-column split (grid-cols-2). Left side: Sticky Hero, Value Prop, CTA. Right side: Interactive Bento Grid showing the product, internally scrolling if necessary, ending in the Pricing toggle.

workspace_layout.sidebar: w-[260px] h-full flex flex-col border-r border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] bg-[#080808] shrink-0
workspace_layout.main_content: flex-1 h-full flex flex-col min-w-0 overflow-hidden relative
workspace_layout.home_overview: h-full flex flex-col p-6 gap-6. Top: Header. Middle: 4-stat strip. Bottom: flex-1 grid grid-cols-12 gap-6 min-h-0.
workspace_layout.internal_scroll_containers: Use overflow-y-auto, overscroll-contain, and custom invisible scrollbars. Apply to 'Recent Activity', 'Timeline', and 'Conversations' lists.

interactions.list_reveal: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}, transition={{ staggerChildren: 0.05, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
interactions.active_tab_dock: layoutId='activeTab' with absolute positioning behind text, bg-[#1f1f1f], rounded-md, type='spring', stiffness=500, damping=35. Creates the 'concave-fillet' illusion.
interactions.hover_scale: whileHover={{ scale: 0.98 }} for list items and source connectors.
interactions.skeleton_loading: Base #171717 with an animated shimmering mask of rgba(255,255,255,0.05) sweeping left to right.

buttons.primary: bg-[#ffffff] text-[#0a0a0a] rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-[13px] font-medium hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#F4F4F5] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.12)] rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-[13px] hover:bg-[#171717]

ask_bracket_ai.composer: Anchored to the bottom of Conversations/Timeline. Pure minimalist terminal feel. border-t border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)], bg-[#080808]/80 backdrop-blur-md. Focus state triggers the focus_glow.
ask_bracket_ai.suggestion_chips: rounded-full border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.12)] text-[#A1A1AA] text-[11px] px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-[#171717] hover:text-[#F4F4F5] transition-colors cursor-pointer

empty_states.container: flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-center p-8 border border-dashed border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] rounded-lg bg-[#0e0e0e]/50

sources_list.item: flex items-center gap-3 p-2 rounded-md hover:bg-[#171717] group cursor-pointer transition-colors
sources_list.icon_wrapper: w-6 h-6 rounded flex items-center justify-center bg-[#1f1f1f] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] grayscale group-hover:grayscale-0 transition-all

data_cards.wrapper: bg-[#0e0e0e] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] rounded-lg p-4 flex flex-col gap-2 hover:bg-[#171717] transition-colors

pricing_toggle.container: inline-flex bg-[#0e0e0e] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] rounded-full p-1
pricing_toggle.tab: relative px-4 py-1.5 text-[13px] z-10 font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer
pricing_toggle.active_bg: absolute inset-0 bg-[#1f1f1f] rounded-full border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.12)] z-0

instructions_to_main_agent.html_structure: Do not use standard web layouts. Use an app-like shell. `<div class='flex h-screen w-full overflow-hidden bg-[#080808]'>` is your root.
instructions_to_main_agent.scrolling: NEVER apply overflow-y-auto to the body, main, or page container. ONLY apply overflow-y-auto to specific interior lists (e.g., Timeline feed, Recent Activity list).
instructions_to_main_agent.color_enforcement: Do not introduce any hex codes other than the ones in this document. Remove all Tailwind default blues, purples, or rings. Override focus rings to use `rgba(255,255,255,0.22)`.
instructions_to_main_agent.typography: Use Geist for general UI and Geist Mono for anything resembling a label, timestamp, data point, or empty state placeholder. Apply uppercase and 0.15em tracking explicitly to the mono labels.
instructions_to_main_agent.modals_dialogs: Ensure Add-source modal and onboarding tour exist in the DOM with Radix UI (shadcn) Dialog, but heavily restyled to remove default white backgrounds. Use surface_level_2 for modal bodies.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_customization: Radically strip shadcn defaults. Remove border-radius on cards if they feel too bubbly (stick to rounded-md or rounded-lg). Remove all generic dropshadows. Use inner borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: Add data-testid attributes to EVERY interactive element (sidebar tabs, source toggles, Ask Bracket send button, pricing toggle).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Do not center align the app container; text-align: left is standard for readability.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-opacity`, or use framer-motion.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). ONLY use the image_urls provided.
Use sonner for toasts, rendered with an inverted dark theme matching the app.
Ensure the final UI feels like a high-end IDE or client OS, not a generic SaaS dashboard.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
